title: Really eBay? Every Sale is Via Promoted??? | Selling | eBay Community

facts.fact: eBay's help page states that the Promoted Listings fee is based on the ad rate set for each listing, and an ad rate is the percentage of an item's total sale amount including item price, shipping, taxes, and other applicable fees.
facts.quote: The fee you are charged is based on the ad rate you set for each listing. An ad rate is the percentage of an item's total sale amount (including item price, shipping, taxes, and any other applicable fees).

facts.fact: A community user claims that with a 5% promotion rate on a $27 item plus $3 sales tax (total $30), the promotion fee would be $1.50.
facts.quote: Let's say you have a 5% promotion rate, and you list an item for $27.... and it sells! So, the buyer then pays for the item but sales tax in the amount of $3 was added on...the buyer paid $30.

facts.fact: A community user says they have sold close to 2,000 items organically over more than a decade and began promoting listings a couple of months before the post.
facts.quote: I've been hobby selling on eBay for over a decade and have sold close to 2,000 items organically over the years.

facts.fact: According to a seller's description of eBay's Halo effect, a buyer who clicks one of a seller's promoted listings activates the Halo effect for that seller's promoted listings for the next 31 days.
facts.quote: the Halo effect has now been activated for all of your promoted listing moving forward for that buyer for the next 31 days.

facts.fact: A seller (a forum user, not eBay) reported 94 sales in the last 90 days, of which 35 were organic and the rest were Promoted Listings sales.
facts.quote: I've had 94 sales in the last 90 days & of those 35 were organic sales & the rest were PL.

facts.fact: A forum seller claims Promoted Listings increased their sales by 3x early on, according to their own account.
facts.quote: They increased my sales by 3x, early on.

facts.fact: A forum seller estimates that roughly 70-80% of their sales come from Promoted Listings, with about 20% organic.
facts.quote: At a glance, I'd say 70-80% PL, but I still have around 20% organic sales

facts.fact: A forum seller reports typically having about one Halo effect sale per month.
facts.quote: I only typically have 1 Halo effect sale per month. It's very rare.

facts.fact: A forum user states that eBay has increased its recommended Promoted Listings rates as more sellers promote to keep their advantage (user claim, not an eBay figure).
facts.quote: eBay has even increased the recommended rates.

facts.fact: eBay's Help pages state that Promoted Listings Standard sellers are charged only when a buyer clicks a promoted listing and purchases a promoted item within 30 days of the click.
facts.quote: You will only be charged when a buyer clicks on your promoted listing and purchases any of your promoted items within 30 days of the click

facts.fact: A forum user who began selling in 1996 reports that their sales tripled in the early days of Promoted Listings, a personal anecdote rather than an eBay figure.
facts.quote: my sales tripled in the early days of PL's

facts.fact: A forum commenter claims that a seller who promotes at a 20% rate pays eBay fees of 40% of the item price, a figure from a user's opinion rather than eBay.
facts.quote: push your promotions to 20% and pay ebay 40% of your items price in fees RIGHT OFF THE TOP

facts.fact: A forum user states they have sold close to 2,000 items organically over more than a decade on eBay before starting Promoted Listings.
facts.quote: have sold close to 2,000 items organically over the years

facts.fact: A forum commenter calculates that a seller who sold about 2,000 items over twelve years averages 167 sales per year and 14 per month.
facts.quote: averaging 167 sales/year, 14 per month

facts.fact: A forum commenter states that a seller sold 140 items in the last three months, averaging 47 per month, per the seller's own report.
facts.quote: You have sold 140 items in the last three months, averaging 47 per month

facts.fact: A forum commenter describes the seller's post-promotion monthly sales as a nearly 250% increase over their prior average.
facts.quote: a nearly 250% increase to your average

facts.fact: A forum user estimates that at least 90% of eBay shoppers do their homework and compare similar listings before buying, an opinion not backed by eBay data.
facts.quote: I would think at least 90% of the shoppers here are doing their homework and comparing similar listings.

facts.fact: A community member states that eBay charges the Promoted Listings fee on the total amount the buyer pays, the same basis used for the regular final value fee.
facts.quote: Ebay does not hide the fact that they charge the PL fee on the total amount the buyer pays, just as they do the regular FVF.

facts.fact: A community member states that eBay's Promoted Listings fee is based on the total plus taxes, which another user calls a money grab; this is a third-party claim, not an eBay statement.
facts.quote: the fact that eBays pls fee is based on total plus taxes is an absolute money grab.

facts.fact: A community member states that Promoted Listings is an optional tool and sellers are not required to use it.
facts.quote: No one forces you to use the tool nor is it a requirement.

facts.fact: A community member states that Promoted Listings is a marketing program used for years by many different companies and that eBay did not invent it.
facts.quote: It is a marketing program used for years by many different companies. Ebay didn't invent it.

facts.fact: Forum user mr_lincoln says eBay fully launched PLA in early 2022 and then changed how views are counted and doubled and tripled PLS ad rates (user's claim, not an eBay statement).
facts.quote: until early 2022 when PLA was fully launched, they changed the way Views are counted and magically doubled and tripled the ad rates for PLS

facts.fact: Forum user mr_lincoln says they ran one PLS campaign per quarter for about 30 days before stopping PLS in the fourth quarter of the prior year (user's account).
facts.quote: ran ONE PLS campaign PER QUARTER for about 30 days

facts.fact: Forum user mr_lincoln reports receiving three 'We've missed you' Promoted Listings Standard messages in the roughly 2.5 months after stopping PLS (user's account).
facts.quote: (3) "We've missed you - try Promoted Listing Standards again."

facts.fact: Forum user femmefan1946 says they usually have about 25-30% of their listings using Standard Promoted Listings (user's account).
facts.quote: I usually have about 25-30% of my listings using Standard PL.

facts.fact: Forum user femmefan1946 says sales from Promoted Listings run about 10% or so, well below their share of listings using PL (user's account).
facts.quote: But my sales with PL run much less than that, about 10% or so.

facts.fact: Forum user femmefan1946 says they only promote items at the minimum ad rate of 2%.
facts.quote: only at the minimum 2%

facts.fact: Forum user janet9988 claims Promoted Listings seem to get bypassed or overlooked on any type of policy violation (anecdotal user claim).
facts.quote: Promoted listings seem to get bypassed or overlooked on any type of policy violation.

facts.fact: A forum poster states that they have been an eBay seller for 24 years.
facts.quote: I have been here 24 years and attest to that.

facts.fact: A forum user says they list items on Promoted Listings at a rate of 15-20%, per their own report.
facts.quote: And they are usually promoted 15-20 %.

facts.fact: A forum user suggests that the minimum Promoted Listings rate they cite as a test is 2%.
facts.quote: just put your listing into PL at a measly 2% and go buck wild with every policy violation in the book.

facts.fact: A forum user states they do not pay more than 25% of what their items sell for in most cases when promoting listings.
facts.quote: I donâ€™t pay more than 25% of what my items sell for in most cases.

facts.fact: A forum user says they could promote at 15% to 20% and still more than double their money, per their own claim.
facts.quote: I could promote at 15% to 20% and still more than double my money but I choose not to.

facts.fact: A forum user says that sales have been declining for close to two years, per the original poster's own account.
facts.quote: sales have been sliding for close to 2 years

facts.fact: A forum user states that Promoted Listings is optional for sellers on eBay.
facts.quote: Promoted listings is OPTIONAL. If you donâ€™t want to do it you donâ€™t have to.
